features.colaboradores: Manage your team, assign jobs and track how each staff member performs.

features.analytics: Analyse trends, traffic sources and business growth metrics.

features.afiliados: Extend your reach with an affiliate programme and automatic commissions.
features.meteorologia: Check weather forecasts and get alerts for days with scheduled tours.
features.integracoes: Connect your business to Viator and GetYourGuide and manage bookings from external platforms in one place.
features.automacoes: Set up automatic email and WhatsApp message sequences for every stage of the booking.
features.fidelidade: Keep your customers coming back with a points programme, rewards and exclusive benefits.
features.grupos: Manage corporate groups, special events and group bookings with centralised invoicing.
features.pacotes: Create seasonal packages and combine services to raise the average spend per customer.
features.parcerias: Set up cross-selling partnerships with other operators and share commissions automatically.
features.previsao: Use historical data and external conditions to forecast demand and optimise availability.
features.financeiro-completo: Track operating expenses, salaries and tax obligations with full reports and exports.
features.vendedor: Turn on Beach Seller mode — staff sell tours in the field with a simplified app.
